Come Join The Fun At The Senior Expo On September 24th! #realestate 

Join us for the Senior Expo at the Cadence Bank Center from 8a-1p on September 24th!! 

We will have a table full of freebies and a prize wheel for you to spin to win! 
You could even win a grabby stick like this one.

This video didn't go as planned, but it made the whole team laugh so we hope it made you laugh too. 

i35 Group is a group of hard-working real estate agents always striving to get the best deal for our buyers and the most money for our sellers. We are neighborhood experts in Central Texas. Choose us for your real estate needs.
